### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/plugin-auth`, touching **3** documentable anchor(s).

**1** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/deployment/environment-variables.mdx`  _(via OS_MIGRATE_AND_EXIT (literal, a string literal in MIGRATE_AND_EXIT_ENV))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **16** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 97cb5c5a821cb1e07b0e0026db9923bdbc860863` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `6ff8e42d1805488baf493f34e4f32a54da95d5d2` — the merge of head `da64a0936064031c71fafc248a29901032a2ecbe` into base `97cb5c5a821cb1e07b0e0026db9923bdbc860863`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 6ff8e42d1805488baf493f34e4f32a54da95d5d2 && git checkout 6ff8e42d1805488baf493f34e4f32a54da95d5d2
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 97cb5c5a821cb1e07b0e0026db9923bdbc860863 da64a0936064031c71fafc248a29901032a2ecbe && git checkout -B drift-repro 97cb5c5a821cb1e07b0e0026db9923bdbc860863 && git merge --no-ff da64a0936064031c71fafc248a29901032a2ecbe

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 97cb5c5a821cb1e07b0e0026db9923bdbc860863
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 97cb5c5a821cb1e07b0e0026db9923bdbc860863` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

CI note · `domain:services` seat 1 (#6021) · `marchtian` · `session_01Nk17Z26X5DB59iQztDBADH` · 2026-10-19T01:08Z · head `da64a09360`

**`Test Core (2/6)` failed, and the failure is not this PR's.** Read from the job's log (job `117837189332`):
- **What failed:** two tests in `packages/cli/test/dev-no-watch.pin.test.ts`: "a PACKAGE that selects no workspace project fails > and the failure is pnpm refusing the PACKAGE …" and "`--no-watch` where os dev boots no environment is refused, not ignored > the fixture starts its own dev script when asked — the control". The shard's summary is `Test Files 1 failed | 155 passed`, `Tests 2 failed | 2129 passed`.
- **Why:** both tests spawn `pnpm` through corepack. In both, corepack's request for `https://registry.npmjs.org/pnpm/latest` was answered `HTTP 429` (rate limited), so the child `os dev` exited 1 before it printed what the tests read.
- **Why it is not this PR's:** this PR changes `plugin-auth` only (`isDevAdminSeedArmed()` and one new test). Neither failing test reads the dev seed or `OS_MIGRATE_AND_EXIT`. No fix exists yet for a test that reaches the public registry, so none is ported.
- **Next:** the failed jobs are re-run once, when this workflow run finishes. A second failure counts as real.

## 席位核对

ACCEPT · `domain:services` seat 1 (#6021) · `marchtian` · `session_01Nk17Z26X5DB59iQztDBADH` · 2026-10-19T01:27Z · head `da64a09360`. This is the seat's own review at `TIER_DEFAULT`. `--tier` read no path-derived mandate, and the diff touches no published schema or governed text. It lands through the merge queue once every check on this head is green. ⚠️ No credential here, under the card's disclosure clause.

- **Shape:**
  - A draft PR to `main`. Its first line is `Fixes #24409`, and that is the only closing keyword in the body.
  - `Clause-②: no` is at a line start in the body and in the changeset (`@objectstack/plugin-auth` `patch`).
  - Card and PR assignee: `marchtian`.
  - Not governed: `check-governed-merges` reads 0 of 3 paths, and 258 changed lines ≤ 3000.
- **The fix, read by the seat:** one clause in `isDevAdminSeedArmed()` (`walled-owner-verification-path.ts`). It answers "not armed" when `OS_MIGRATE_AND_EXIT` is exactly `'1'`, the spelling `serve.ts:5447` exits on, and it sits after the `NODE_ENV` gate.
  - `maybeSeedDevAdmin` gates on this function and nothing else.
  - The walled owner check reads the same function, so the seed and the check stay in agreement, as the card's Wanted requires.
  - `auth-plugin.ts` and `serve.ts` are not edited.
- **The card's Done when, each met:**
  1. **Measured on real migrate-and-exit boots** (`os serve`, `NODE_ENV=development`, an empty SQLite store). On `44a5011fe` the boot left one `sys_user` and one `sys_account` row. After the fix it leaves none, `OS_SEED_ADMIN=1` included. A new pin over a real ObjectQL and SQL driver holds this.
  2. **The `objectstack dev` seed is unchanged.** It is armed on an empty dev store and off under `OS_SEED_ADMIN=0`. All five dev-seed pin files (63 cases) pass.
  3. **The walled case completes.** `OS_MULTI_ORG_ENABLED=true` with a declared owner and membership policy: exit 0, "Migration complete", 65 tables, no login. The walled owner check is warn-only and refuses nothing. The only walled refusals measured read no seed state and are identical before and after.
- **Ablation:** dropping the clause turned 5 of the 9 new cases red, with the 4 controls green. The restore is blob-equal to HEAD.
- **Semver: `patch` with a bare `Clause-②: no` stands.** This is the seat's reading, named because #24366's review turned on this question.
  - No door's accept set, schema, export or documented contract moves. The dev found no doc page, skill or README saying a migrate boot seeds.
  - `OS_SEED_ADMIN` has only off spellings. `=1` equals unset, so the clause overrides no explicit opt-in.
  - What it ends is an unintended side effect of a dev-only seed on a boot that never serves.
  - That differs from #24366, which narrowed what a published HTTP route family accepts and falsified a docs sentence.
- **Gates on this head:** 34 checks succeeded and 6 were skipped by design (Build Docs, Console Pin Gate, Dogfood Regression Gate, Dogfood Verify CLI, Packed-tarball smoke, Temporal Conformance: the roster set). There were no failures on run attempt 2, and the required contexts are green. `Test Core (2/6)` failed on attempt 1 in `packages/cli/test/dev-no-watch.pin.test.ts`, on an `HTTP 429` from the npm registry while corepack fetched pnpm, which is not this diff (CI note `6257506863`). Its one re-run passed, and the flake is filed as #24419. Locally the dev derived 67 families, ran all 67, and all exited 0 (`--ran`: 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN). One of them, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, first exited 3 on an unbuilt prerequisite and passed after the build.
- **Accepted deviations:**
  - **The branch was not merged with later `main`.** The two commits since touch only `AGENTS.md`, two ADRs and `examples/README.md`, and the merge queue tests the merged tree.
  - **The walled measurement's exact env is an assumption** (`OS_AUTH_MEMBERSHIP_POLICY=invite-only` beside a declared owner). cloud#3045's env is not readable from this container, and without a declared policy the walled boot is refused before and after alike.
- **Out-of-scope, Acceptance notes:**
  - Two comments in `auth-plugin.ts`'s `maybeSeedDevAdmin` list fewer clauses than the gate now has. They are still true, and `isDevAdminSeedArmed`'s docblock lists all three.
  - On the real walled boots the `walled_owner_no_verification_path` warning did not print on base either, likely because the default composition wires an email transport. This is an observation, not reproduced as a defect.
- **Downstream:** cloud picks this up at its next `.objectstack-sha` move, and cloud#3046 closes against it (the card's Downstream line).
